description: Machine-readable map of routes, contexts, services, hooks, lib modules and key components. Paths are relative to MeetSweet-mobile/ (the app dir).

boot.app/index.tsx: Valid session → (tabs); else Welcome. Never shows a broken half-authenticated state.

auth.app/forgot-password.tsx: 4-step reset: email → code → new password → done

tabs.app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: Tab bar (Home/Explore/Messages/Profile) + header wallet badge + AUTH GATE (logged-out → Welcome/Login)

content.app/content/[id].tsx: Unified post/album detail with pinned MsComposer (modern comments path)
content.app/post/[id].tsx: Legacy post detail (share links resolve here; comments in MsCommentsSheet modal)
content.app/album/[id].tsx: Album detail: locked → purchase CTA → confirm sheet → unlock → content revealed

deep_link.app/s/[token].tsx: Share-token resolver → exact destination (post/album/creator); works logged-out; returns to destination after login

contexts.contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Tokens (access in memory, refresh in SecureStore); login/register/logout; single-flight 401 refresh; session-expiry → clear → redirect Login; logout clears chat caches + per-account prefs
contexts.contexts/WalletContext.tsx: Wallet balance shared by wallet screen + Home header badge (MsWalletBadge); updates propagate immediately from server responses
contexts.contexts/PostActionsContext.tsx: Optimistic like/comment/subscribe reconciled with server-authoritative responses

services.services/api.ts: Fetch wrapper: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL base, Bearer header, 401 → single-flight refresh → retry once; refresh failure → logout redirect
services.services/comment-room-service.ts: Comment rooms + comments + likes + changes polling
services.services/chat-cache.ts: SQLite chat cache (rooms/messages/drafts), cleared on logout/account switch
services.services/media.ts: Direct-to-R2 upload: authorize → presigned PUT (or multipart parts) → complete
services.services/video-cache.ts: Local video byte cache with stable logical URLs

lib.lib/deep-link.ts: Share-token resolution → destination screens (no onboarding/home flash)
lib.lib/screen-protection.ts: Global capture prevention via expo-screen-capture + modal theme override
lib.lib/api-client-react: React bindings for the shared API client

plugins.plugins/withSecureWindow.js: Expo config plugin setting FLAG_SECURE natively (app-wide screenshot/screen-record blocking on Android)

key_components.MsVideoPlayer.tsx: Single react-native-video player: play/pause/seek/fullscreen; stable source URL; used for posts, shorts, albums, DMs, previews
key_components.MsComposer.tsx: Multiline composer; send via button (Enter does not submit)
key_components.MsGlobalDialogs.tsx: App-wide dialog host (mounted in root layout)

key_interactions.auth: AuthContext owns tokens; services/api.ts auto-refreshes on 401; expired session → Login redirect; tabs + push screens are auth-gated so no logged-out placeholder (U) state exists
key_interactions.wallet_sync: Server mutation (fund/purchase) → WalletContext balance update → wallet screen + header badge update immediately, no restart
key_interactions.realtime: Like/comment/subscribe mutations return authoritative state → PostActionsContext applies instantly; chat/comment rooms poll /changes endpoints
key_interactions.deep_links: meetsweet://s/<token> → app/s/[token].tsx → lib/deep-link.ts → exact destination; logged-out users authenticate then return to the destination
key_interactions.media_upload: services/media.ts → POST /api/uploads (server) → presigned R2 PUT/multipart → complete → media row → attach to post/album
key_interactions.video_playback: MsVideoPlayer with stable source URL from server; local video-cache stores bytes but never swaps the playing URL; seek lands at the target time (no restart-from-0)
